types.name: GroupComponent
types.doc:
Marks an actor as a group of the actors parented under it (Ctrl+G in the
editor). A locked group is picked and moved as one: clicking any member in
the viewport selects the group. Unlocked, the members are picked on their
own and the group is only a parent.

members.name: roll
members.doc:
Degrees about the curve's direction here: what a mesh laid along the
spline, or a camera riding it, rolls by. Blended linearly between points.

members.name: scale
members.doc: Cross-section scale for a mesh laid along the spline (width, height).

members.name: linear
members.doc:
The segment leaving this point is a straight line instead of a curve,
which is what a corner of a wall or a fence needs.

types.name: SplineComponent
types.doc:
A curve through authored points in the owning actor's local space: paths,
rails, roads, cables, camera tracks. The water and terrain splines keep
their own point types because their points carry channels this one has no
use for; this is the general one gameplay and the editor share.

types.name: FSplineMath
types.doc:
Sampling for SplineComponent points. Everything is in the points' own space
(the actor's local space) and addressed by input key: key k lies on the
segment from point floor(k) to the next, so 0 is the first point and
SegmentCount the last (or the first again, on a closed loop). A curved
segment is uniform Catmull-Rom through its neighbours, which passes through
every point; a point marked linear makes the segment leaving it straight.

types.name: EMobility
types.doc:
UE's three mobilities. Static and Stationary actors keep their place once
play starts (a runtime move is refused with a warning); a Stationary one
may still change what it emits — a light's colour and intensity — where a
Static one is meant to be fixed outright. Stationary is appended so levels
written while only Static (0) and Movable (1) existed read unchanged.

members.name: position
members.doc: Shown as UE's "Location"; the key stays "position".

members.name: rotation
members.doc:
Stored in radians, edited in degrees. The inspector reads that off the
unit rather than off this component's name, which is what it did before.

members.name: worldMatrix
members.doc: Computed by TransformSystem each frame

members.name: lastPosition
members.doc:
Mirror of the local fields as of the last TransformSystem pass. The next
pass memcmps them against the live fields to skip clean subtrees, so
there is no MarkDirty() — plain field writes are detected. NaN init
forces a full rebuild on the first frame.

members.name: worldVersion
members.doc:
worldVersion bumps on every worldMatrix rebuild; children compare it
against lastParentVersion to catch a moved parent (their own local
fields are unchanged but their world position is stale).

members.name: shadowSeenVersion
members.doc:
The worldVersion the shadow pass last saw and the render frame it last
changed on: a Movable caster that moved recently draws in the dynamic
shadow layer instead of invalidating the cached static one.

members.name: lastParent
members.doc:
The parent worldMatrix was last composed against. Versions are
per-entity counters, so a child moved to a new parent whose version
happens to equal the old one's — or unparented, with no parent version
left to compare — kept the old parent's world matrix without this.

members.name: firstChildSlotHint
members.doc:
World slot hints for the RelationshipComponent links TransformSystem
follows (this entity's first child, its next sibling), so the hierarchy
walk reaches a child without the id → slot hash. Checked against the id
on every use; a stale or copied hint just costs the hash once.

members.name: GetLocalMatrix
members.doc:
Order: Scale -> RotZ -> RotY -> RotX -> Translate, i.e. T * Rx * Ry * Rz * S,
composed analytically: the 3x3 block is Rx*Ry*Rz expanded with its columns
scaled, ~30 ops instead of four Mat4 products. Rounding differs from the
matrix product only in op order; equivalence is locked by --trs-test.

members.name: GetMatrix
members.doc: Local only — parented entities need GetWorldMatrix().

members.name: GetWorldMatrix
members.doc: Baked by TransformSystem each frame. For root entities == GetLocalMatrix().

members.name: GetWorldPosition
members.doc: Extracted from worldMatrix, so it includes the parent transform.

members.name: GetForward
members.doc:
Basis columns of R = Rx * Ry * Rz — the exact rotation GetLocalMatrix
bakes and Quat::FromEuler/ToEuler round-trip, so a decomposed quat
(actor sync, physics, imports) yields the same vectors as the quat
itself. Forward = R * (0, 0, -1); the -Z column has no roll terms.

members.name: GetRight
members.doc: Right is +X: R * (1, 0, 0) — roll participates here.
